tagline: 理光取景器相机，1993 年发布
description: 理光于1993年推出的取景器相机。配备Ricoh Lens 34mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度1/50 sec. and 1/100 sec.。感光度ISO 100 or 400 (DX-Code system)。fixed-focus。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 34mm f/4.5, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.英文简介: The LX-25 is a fixed-focus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1993.
